free_tier.stated: Store up to 1 TB of data in OneLake on a trial capacity

retention.stated: The trial capacity lasts 60 days; after it ends all content remains stored in OneLake for 7 days and can be reactivated by assigning the workspace to a paid Fabric F or Power BI Premium P capacity

egress.terms: Paid OneLake storage is billed per GB used; data-transfer charges are not itemised on the trial page, and choosing a capacity region minimizes ingress and egress charges.

chaining: OneLake accepts existing ADLS and Blob tools through dfs.fabric.microsoft.com endpoints, and exposes shortcuts to data sources outside OneLake.

limits.value: 60-day trial capacity; content kept 7 days after it ends

reliability_note: 1 TB but 60 days only; after expiry non-Power BI items go inactive and content is retained just 7 days. Great API surface (DFS + Blob), wrong duration for a 20 TB archive.
